app_title: How close is your Korean to TOPIK Level 2?
app_subtitle: A free diagnostic test for foreigners working in Korea. 15 questions, about 5 minutes.
intro_point_1: TOPIK Level 2 is required for the E-7-4 skilled worker visa and the Social Integration Program (KIIP).
intro_point_2: See your current level and exactly how many points you need to reach Level 2.
result_gap_pass: Keep this up and you can pass Level 2.
result_disclaimer: Note: this is an estimate based on reading questions only. The real exam also includes listening and writing.
lead_prompt: Want your result sheet and a study plan to pass Level 2?
lead_consent: I agree to receive study information. You can unsubscribe any time.
lead_thanks: Thank you! We'll send it soon.
share_text: How close am I to TOPIK Level 2? Try this free test:
intro_about: hango is an early-stage service built by one developer. We're building tools to help you study Korean after the test.
lead_subnote: You'll also hear when hango's study materials are ready.
